text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp in the Senior Year is 
about to begin. However, Symboli Kris S 
seems lost in melancholy lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is a crucial period for securing 
consecutive victories in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Her Trainer resolves to uncover 
what she has been carrying inside during 
the training camp.
